bugs.title: ADC average overflows int, producing negative percent
bugs.description: `sum` is declared as `int` (line 11) but accumulates up to 50 raw ADC samples (line 54); with rail-to-rail readings near 1023 the sum reaches ~51150, overflowing the 16-bit signed int and wrapping negative. The wrapped value is divided by `n` (line 59) and scaled in `rawToPct` (lines 19-20), yielding the measured -140.3 % / -297.7 % / -265.4 % outputs against injected 500.0 % / 350.0 % / 400.4 %. Firmware printed -140.3 % at 996 ms while the injected input was 500.0 to 500.0 %: off by 640.3 % (tolerance ±3). 4 of 7 values were wrong.

bugs.title: Button handling blocks loop and stretches pct period
bugs.description: When D5 is held LOW, every loop iteration calls `forceSampleNote()` and `delay(30)` (lines 65-69) on top of `delay(IDLE_MS)` (line 79), so the 50-sample window takes far longer than 1 s and the `pct:` stream drifts, measured as a 2523 ms gap. Button bounce and rapid presses add extra blocking delays without debouncing, producing the measured 1246-1337 ms gaps. Expected /^pct: / every 1000 ± 150 ms; 4 of 7 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 1246 ms.
